DEEP AUDIT AND FIX the global CSS, layout, and project structure. No planning — read, compare, fix.

Project: `/Users/yashbaldha/Desktop/Boldteq App/Boldteq/`

## Task 1: Verify globals.css matches Webflow design tokens
1. Read `/Users/yashbaldha/Desktop/Boldteq App/Boldteq/boldteq-v1-0.webflow/css/boldteq-v1-0.webflow.css` — extract ALL :root variables, base body styles, and global reset styles
2. Read `/Users/yashbaldha/Desktop/Boldteq App/Boldteq/src/app/globals.css`
3. Ensure our CSS variables and utilities match the Webflow source exactly
4. Add any missing global styles (body font-size, line-height, letter-spacing, color defaults)

## Task 2: Verify layout.tsx is correct
1. Read the `<head>` section of `/Users/yashbaldha/Desktop/Boldteq App/Boldteq/boldteq-v1-0.webflow/index.html` — extract ALL meta tags, structured data (JSON-LD), verification tags, canonical URL, OG tags
2. Read `/Users/yashbaldha/Desktop/Boldteq App/Boldteq/src/app/layout.tsx`
3. Ensure metadata matches Webflow exactly
4. Check font loading is correct (RoobertPRO with all 4 weights)
5. Verify body classes match Webflow body styles

## Task 3: Clean project structure
1. List all files in `src/` recursively
2. Remove any unused files (old boilerplate like next.svg, vercel.svg, globe.svg, file.svg, window.svg in public/)
3. Remove `src/components/ui/button-link.tsx` if it exists but isn't imported anywhere (check with grep)
4. Verify `src/lib/constants/` files have clean, typed data
5. Check `src/types/` files are correct and used
6. Verify all imports across all files resolve correctly

## Task 4: Add missing Webflow base styles to globals.css
From the Webflow CSS, the body has specific defaults. Check and add:
- Default body font-size, line-height, color
- Default heading styles (h1-h6 margins, weights)
- Default link styles
- Default image max-width
- Any utility classes used across multiple components that should be global

## Task 5: Verify image references
1. List all images referenced in the Next.js components (grep for `/images/webflow/`)
2. Verify each referenced image exists in `public/images/webflow/`
3. Report and fix any broken references

## Rules
- Fix everything directly — don't just audit
- No `any` types
- Keep code clean and minimal
- Remove dead code and unused files
